info.title: Nexus baseline API
info.description: Implemented development baseline only. Not production certified. Exact GPS appears ONLY on authenticated location ingress. Public projection never returns coordinates. See docs/READINESS.md for incomplete modules. Response DTO schemas below describe critical privacy boundaries; not every operation is fully typed yet.
